judgment_refs.note: Department of Transportation designation or local authority with Department approval requires an original administrative source.

judgment_refs.phrase: erect official traffic-control devices at such crossings directing a stop
judgment_refs.note: Original installed official stop sign and approach governance require separate source review.

judgment_refs.phrase: within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest track
judgment_refs.note: Original nearest-track and vehicle geometry yield front, centre and rear distances; the statute does not specify a vehicle reference point.

judgment_refs.phrase: afterward may proceed only upon exercising due care
judgment_refs.note: Retain motion, visibility, occluder and actual train state; no numerical due-care substitute.
